data_description.dataset_name: MAXAR Open Data Multispectral: Turkey Earthquake 2023

spatial_coverage.coverage: High-resolution pre- and post-earthquake satellite imagery covering earthquake-affected regions in Turkey and surrounding areas from the February 2023 earthquake event.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Pre-event and post-event imagery from 2023 Turkey earthquake. Imagery captured in response to the disaster activation.
data_description.data_format: Google Earth Engine ImageCollection asset - Analysis-ready multispectral imagery
data_description.spatial_resolution: Sub-meter to meter resolution (MAXAR high-resolution commercial satellite imagery)
data_description.data_type_numeric: Multispectral bands: Red, Green, Blue, Near-Infrared
data_description.important_note: This dataset is part of MAXAR's Open Data Program, providing analysis-ready high-resolution imagery for emergency response and damage assessment. Images are generated using the MAXAR ARD pipeline and tiled on an organized grid in cloud-optimized formats.
analytical_capabilities: Emergency response planning and staging area monitoring
Multispectral analysis for material and structural assessment

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Digital numbers representing spectral reflectance in Red, Green, Blue, and Near-Infrared bands at sub-meter to meter spatial resolution.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use band combinations for RGB visualization and change detection. NIR band can help identify vegetation changes and structural materials. Compare pre-event and post-event scenes for damage assessment.

data_description.data_source: MAXAR Open Data Program via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
